notes: the second isnad («وابن، جريج عن عطاء») is written without its own head, so that group starts at Ibn Jurayj as the text writes him

occurrence numbers count repeated words: «عطاء», «صفوان بن يعلى» and «يعلى» each stand twice or more in the text
